review_candidates.title: IT & Infrastructure Engineer (Global Recruitment / Relocation to Japan)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Requirements & Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 3 years of proven hands-on experience in IT (Software Development or Infrastructure). How to Apply If you meet the requirements—especially the JLPT N2 language proficiency and a strong desire to relocate to Japan for the long term—please submit your resume/CV in English or Japanese.
eligibility_evidence: We are looking for talented global IT professionals who are ready to build a long-term, stable career and relocate to Japan.
Commitment to Relocation: Genuine intention and commitment to relocate and build a long-term career in Japan (minimum of 5 years).
Strong Perks & Benefits (Relocation Support) Subsidized Corporate Housing (Major Benefit): TechnoPro offers a corporate housing system.
Comprehensive Relocation Package: Visa sponsorship, flight arrangements, and housing support.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Requirements & Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 3 years of proven hands-on experience in IT (Software Development or Infrastructure). Language Proficiency: JLPT N2 (Advanced Japanese / Business Fluency) is mandatory . How to Apply If you meet the requirements—especially the JLPT N2 language proficiency and a strong desire to relocate to Japan for the long term—please submit your resume/CV in English or Japanese.
